subject: Request: Reactivate lapsed trial + promotional credit approval
thread_body:
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@acmeai.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial expired — request for reactivation and credits

Hi Diego,

We were running an evaluation of Redwood last month (trial started Jan 7) and the account appears to have lapsed last week. We still have an internal demo and benchmark to finish for the engineering review, and the missing credits are blocking us from completing final tests.

Is there any possibility to get a short reactivation window (2–3 weeks) and a small promo credit top-up (around $400) so our team can finish the evaluation? If approved we should be able to convert to a paid Dedicated trial by end of March.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

Olivia Martin
Head of ML, Acme AI
olivia@acmeai.com

---

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@acmeai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial expired — request for reactivation and credits

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and sorry for the interruption. I pulled your usage and trial history (attached is a quick CSV export) and I can propose reactivating your trial for 21 days with a $500 promotional credit to cover the remaining evaluation runs.

Before I proceed I need approval from my manager and finance since this goes beyond the standard 30-day extension. Could you confirm the team that will be running the workloads and whether any compliance docs are still outstanding? Also tagging Marissa from our account team to help coordinate the timeline.

Baseline next steps:
- I’ll request internal approval today (diego)
- If approved, we’ll reactivate and add promo credit, send you a promo-code PDF and updated trial window
- Marissa will schedule a quick sync to confirm acceptance criteria for conversion to Dedicated

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0193

ATTACHMENT: acme_trial_history.csv (CSV export of trial usage and expiration)

---

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request — Acme AI reactivation + $500 credit (RWI-DEAL-202602-A1)

Hi Neha and Vivek,

Quick request: Acme AI (Olivia Martin) had a trial lapse last week; they’re asking for a 21-day reactivation and a $500 promotional credit to finish benchmarks. Customer indicates conversion potential to Dedicated in March if the evaluation completes. I’ve attached the usage export.

Relevant notes:
- Trial originally started 2026-01-07, expired 2026-02-13
- Current ACV signal: mid-market SaaS with ML infra budget; expected first-year committed spend ~$120k if they convert to Dedicated
- Risk: setting precedent for promo credits but this is a time-limited reactivation tied to conversion criteria

Request: approval to issue a one-time $500 promo credit and reactivate trial for 21 days; we’ll include standard promo terms (see attached).

Marissa, please coordinate the conversion cadence if approved.

Thanks,
Diego

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request — Acme AI reactivation + $500 credit (RWI-DEAL-202602-A1)

Diego — approved.

Reasoning: customer shows clear intent and decent conversion likelihood; $500 is within regional promotional allowance. Please ensure we document the conversion acceptance criteria in HubSpot and attach the promo-terms.txt to the deal.

Vivek — FYI on the exception; let me know if you want the finance review but I’m comfortable approving.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, West Region | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@acmeai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial expired — request for reactivation and credits

Hi Olivia — good news: Neha approved the request. We’ve reactivated your trial window for 21 days (now open until 2026-03-13) and applied a $500 promo credit to the account.

Attached is the promo-credit-approval.pdf (signed internal approval stub) and the promo-terms.txt that outlines the one-time nature of the top-up and the conversion acceptance criteria we discussed. Please note the credit will apply only to hosted usage and cannot be combined with other offers.

Next steps:
- Your team should see credits in the billing portal within 30 minutes.
- Marissa will reach out to schedule a 30-minute hands-on demo and to capture the conversion acceptance checklist.

If anything is missing (legal or compliance docs), loop legal@acmeai.com and I’ll have our security team surface any required evidence.

Thanks — and looking forward to the final benchmarks.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
